description: Automates the entire client onboarding process from contract signing to project kickoff

nodes.name: Trigger: Proposal Accepted
nodes.notes: Manual trigger when client accepts proposal/contract

nodes.name: Send Welcome Email

parameters.subject: 🎉 Welcome Aboard! Here's What Happens Next
parameters.html:
Welcome to the Team! 🚀

Hi {{$json.clientName}},

I'm thrilled to work with you on {{$json.projectName}}!

What Happens Next:

📋 Step 1: Contract & Payment (Today)

Please sign the contract and submit the deposit payment:

  • 📄 Sign Contract
  • 💳 Submit Deposit ({{$json.depositAmount}})

📁 Step 2: Access Your Client Portal

I've created a shared workspace for our project:

Access Client Portal

Inside you'll find:

  • Project roadmap & timeline
  • Shared files folder
  • Meeting notes
  • Progress updates

🗓️ Step 3: Kickoff Call

Once payment is received, we'll schedule our kickoff call to dive into requirements.

📞 Questions?

Just reply to this email or text me: {{$json.yourPhone}}

Excited to get started!
Jeffery | DELLYKNOWSTECH

nodes.notes: Welcome email with contract, payment link, and client portal

nodes.name: Create Client Portal (Google Drive/Notion)
nodes.notes: Creates shared Google Drive folder for client files

nodes.name: Wait for Contract Signature
nodes.notes: Webhook triggered by DocuSign/HelloSign when contract signed

parameters.subject: Contract Signed! ✅ Ready to Build
parameters.html:
Perfect! 🎉

Hi {{$json.clientName}},

Contract signed! Once the deposit payment clears (usually 1-2 business days), we'll kick things off.

While You Wait:

  1. Check out your client portal: Client Portal
  2. Upload any reference materials (logos, branding, examples)
  3. Jot down any additional ideas or requirements

Timeline Reminder:

  • Start Date: {{$json.startDate}}
  • Expected Completion: {{$json.completionDate}}
  • First Milestone: {{$json.milestone1}}

I'll send you a kickoff call invite once payment processes.

Questions? Just reply!
Jeffery

nodes.name: Wait for Payment
nodes.notes: Webhook from Stripe when payment received

nodes.name: Send Kickoff Scheduling Email

parameters.subject: 🚀 Let's Kick This Off! Schedule Your First Call
parameters.html:
Payment Received! 💰

Hi {{$json.clientName}},

Awesome news — your deposit payment just cleared!

Next Step: Kickoff Call

Let's schedule our project kickoff call to finalize requirements and get started.

Pick a time that works for you:

Schedule Kickoff Call

What We'll Cover:

  • Detailed requirements walkthrough
  • Design preferences & branding
  • Access credentials (if needed)
  • Timeline confirmation
  • Your questions

Typically takes 30-45 minutes.

See you soon!
Jeffery

nodes.notes: Asks client to schedule kickoff meeting
